rules: H1 (Hero): text-5xl md:text-6xl+ tracking-tighter leading-none. MUST be Cormorant Garamond or Bodoni Moda.
Labels/Metadata: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono (IBM Plex Mono). Used for edition numbers, catalog IDs, and small labels.
Embrace italics in headings for editorial flair (e.g., 'The Collector\'s Edition').
Use #F4F0EA (Warm Cream) as the definitive background color.
Use #C85A43 (Terracotta) exclusively for primary CTAs, hover states, and critical accents.
Strictly AVOID neon, pure white (#FFFFFF), pure black (#000000), or gradients.
Text should be a very dark charcoal (#1C1C1A) to mimic printer ink.

textures: Subtle SVG noise or CSS grain overlay on the entire body to mimic paper texture (opacity: 0.03).
decorations: Print Registration Marks: Add delicate '+' marks (absolute positioned) in corners of large hero or catalog images.
CSS Letterpress Rules: Use 1px solid #DED8CE for section dividers. Sometimes use a double border (3px double #1C1C1A) to separate headers from content.
shadows: NO standard drop shadows. Use 1px solid borders to define edges. If shadow is absolutely needed for a dropdown, use a sharp solid shadow (e.g., 4px 4px 0px #1C1C1A).
border_radius: 0px everywhere. Sharp corners exclusively to emulate cut paper and physical print.

buttons.primary: bg-[#C85A43] text-[#F4F0EA] rounded-none px-6 py-3 uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-mono hover:bg-[#B04D38] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#1C1C1A] text-[#1C1C1A] rounded-none px-6 py-3 uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-mono hover:bg-[#1C1C1A] hover:text-[#F4F0EA] transition-colors

inputs.default: rounded-none border-b border-[#1C1C1A] border-t-0 border-l-0 border-r-0 bg-transparent focus:ring-0 focus:border-[#C85A43] px-0 py-2 text-base

shadcn_overrides.cards: Remove all rounded corners and soft shadows. Use border border-[#DED8CE] bg-transparent.
shadcn_overrides.dialogs_drawers: Must slide in or fade in with 0px border radius, bg-[#F4F0EA], and sharp borders.
shadcn_overrides.tables: Use for order history. Border-collapse, sharp borders, font-mono for IDs.

grids_layouts.catalog: Swiss/Bento inspired. Not standard cards. Use a CSS grid where grid lines are visible (border-r and border-b on items).
grids_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections. Large margins to create 'breathing room' like a magazine spread.

motion.lenis: Mandatory. Install and setup @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth scroll.

framer_motion.masked_reveal: For H1 hero text. Map text into lines. Wrap each line in an overflow-hidden div. Animate the inner text from y: '100%' to y: '0%' with a spring or custom cubic-bezier.
framer_motion.scroll_reveal: Fade and slight translateY (e.g., 20px) on sections as they enter viewport.
framer_motion.parallax_hero: Use useScroll and useTransform to move a central hero image slightly slower than the scroll speed.

motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Very slow speed (e.g., speed={20}). Text should be large, italicized serif, or uppercase mono separated by '✦'.

media.3d_libraries: Not strictly required unless adding a simple Framer Motion 3D card tilt for the CD cover, but stick to 2D parallax for elegance.

rules: If applied in cart, give 50% off poster products only.
Store a flag 'promo_applied: true' on the order object.
In Customer Dashboard: If 'promo_applied' is true, DO NOT display the tracking number or courier brand. ONLY show the timeline (packed/shipped/delivered).

products.note: CD Box with printed cover only. No game disc.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use typical glowing tech/gaming aesthetic. This MUST look like a high-end physical print catalog or vinyl reissue label.
Implement a numbered 'Manifesto Chapters' section (e.g., 'I. THE PRINT', 'II. THE ARCHIVE') using the serif font.
For the hero, use Framer Motion to create a 'kinetic editorial hero with masked line-by-line reveal' (overflow hidden, text translates up).
Implement a mock or real Razorpay checkout flow in the cart.
Create two main dashboards: Customer (showing order history + timeline + tracking) and Admin (table to update status, add courier/tracking ID).
Strictly enforce the FREEHOSTEL5050 promo code logic (50% off posters, removes tracking ID visibility for customer).
All components must be heavily customized to remove standard Tailwind/Shadcn rounded corners. Use 0px border-radius.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='checkout-button', data-testid='promo-input').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
NEVER use generic AI emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com) - use the exact URLs provided in this JSON.
DO NOT use transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Ensure nav text is readable.
